text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P0] Automated alert: logs-forwarder pipeline delivered files to external S3 bucket s3://tmp-logs-external-123. Possible Authorization headers found. Pager -> @alex_kim

alex_kim: Oncall here, investigating. Which service pushed? @mateo can you check recent deploys for log-forwarder-prod?

mateo: I saw a canary config change at 14:08. Lambda `log-forwarder-prod` had its destination env var updated to external bucket (accidental). Pausing the function now.

infra-bot: Executed: `aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name log-forwarder-prod --environment Variables={FORWARD_S3=disabled}` -> success

alex_kim: grabbing a sample from the bucket to confirm. if auth headers present we need immediate rotation. @nora_support start customer-impact triage. @priya_patel prepare key rotation plan.

alex_kim: sample log snippet (sanitized) below:
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] INFO forwarder sent to s3://tmp-logs-external-123/2026/03/20/abc.log
{"request_id":"r-0xabc","user":"acct_123","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1...","User-Agent":"redwood-client/1.2.3"}}
```

priya_patel: Confirmed presence of bearer tokens in logs. KMS team notified. I am initiating service-token rotation and revocation for session tokens issued in the last 24h. ETA for rotation scripts to finish: ~12m.

mateo: I created a snapshot of the external bucket for forensics: `s3://snapshots/5067894321/` and set bucket ACL to private. Added deny policy for non-org principals.

mateo: Commands run:
```
aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket tmp-logs-external-123 --acl private
aws s3 cp s3://tmp-logs-external-123 s3://snapshots/5067894321 --recursive
```

leah_legal: tagging legal. We need to know PII exposure and customer IDs affected before any outbound notification. Please preserve chain of custody for the snapshot.

nora_support: Support standby. I'll prepare internal template and gather affected tenant IDs from the logs (script running). Will not send customer notices until legal OK.

alex_kim: Initial scope estimate: ~12 files, ~180 session tokens across 3 tenants (acct_123, acct_789, acct_456). Tokens appear to be short-lived (expires <24h) but we'll treat as sensitive and rotate.

priya_patel: Rotation status: started revocation job (job-id rj-5067). Revoke API calls underway to auth-service. Pushing a canary revoke on one tenant now to validate no user-impact.

mateo: Taking over as incident lead for mitigation/forensics. Will post hourly. Alex stepping off pager. @pagerbot please reassign pager to mateo.

pagerbot: Acknowledged. Pager reassigned: @mateo is now primary. :bell:

leah_legal: Quick checklist: (1) preserve snapshot (2) list affected customers (3) determine regulatory exposure (GDPR/CCPA) (4) review breach notification thresholds. Hold PR language until we confirm scope.

nora_support: Collected tenant IDs and sample request_ids. Preparing redacted summary for legal review.

alex_kim: Post-mitigation tasks: 1) verify revocations completed 2) rotate any service keys referenced in logs 3) add stricter deploy guardrails for forwarder env changes 4) run repro to ensure no additional exfil.

priya_patel: Service key rotation kicked off. Also creating a deploy-block rule: require `FORWARD_S3` approval flag on prod deploys.

mateo: Forensics note: logs include request paths and minimal payloads, no bank details observed in quick scan. We'll hand off full analysis to sec-research.

leah_legal: Good. Keep this channel for internal coordination. If exposure expands, we will escalate communications.

mateo: Hourly update (14:35): lambda disabled, bucket access locked, snapshot preserved, revocation job 60% complete. No customer-facing notices yet.

nora_support: 14:37: Support ready with draft customer template (internal link). Prepared FAQ for affected tenants.

priya_patel: 14:42: revocation job finished. Confirmed tokens invalidated. KMS rotation complete for affected service keys.

mateo: 14:45: Running validation sweep across ingress logs to detect additional leaked artifacts. If none seen in next 30m will mark containment achieved.

alex_kim: Thanks team. Leaving final handoff to mateo for postmortem and follow-ups.

mateo: 15:03: containment confirmed. Preparing incident report and playbook updates. Will open a postmortem and assign action items (deploy guardrails, CI checks, improve logging redaction).

leah_legal: 15:07: Legal reviewed drafts; hold on external notifications until postmortem & risk assessment complete.

nora_support: 15:10: Support queued customer comms draft for legal review.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> contained. Playbook run IDs: rj-5067, snap-5067894321.

mateo: 15:18: Closing handoff. Action owners will be tracked in the postmortem. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
